[size=3]Dark Creatures And Cuties is a content pack mod for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30138]Nature In The Valley[/url] which adds 25 new creatures to your game. These creatures generally have a dark, witchy and or cute aesthetic to them! Some will be dangerous, some will be friends, find and catch them all! This mod also adds a new reward for donating all the creatures included in this mod (A new hat).

If you only want to play with the creatures from this mod and not from the base mod (Nature In The Valley) there is a configuration option in that mod to "Use content packs only" which you can activate after downloading this mod.[/size][size=3]

Most of the creatures added have their own place in the insectarium, and their own terrariums. More info on all that can be found on the NITV page.


[/size][color=#b4a7d6][b][u][size=6]Compatibility[/size][/u]
[/b]
[/color][size=3]This mod is compatible with Nature In The Valley and all other content packs for it. This mod should by extension be compatible with all other mods NITV is compatible with, though let me know of any issues! Any issues from the base mod should be posted on it's page and not here.[/size]


[color=#b4a7d6][u][size=6][b]Configuration[/b][/size][/u]

[/color][size=3]This mod has a config option for every creature, allowing you to choose whether or not it is included in your game, as well as how rare it is. There is an extra config option to choose how much damage dangerous creatures do.[/size]
